reviews.title: Want to have your PC case stand out? This is 1 way to do it
reviews.comment:
Quite possibly the best case fans I have purchased. Very colorful and don’t make a lot of noise, and for only $35, you get the best “Bang for your buck.” RGB, infinite mirror design, daisy chain, plug in, installed. Was debating Lian Li fans over these, but bought these instead and glad that I did.
These fans function very well, compatible with any fan hub that has a 3 pin ARGB header on the hub itself.
Overall a great pick, would definitely buy again
reviews.author: Hunter

reviews.title: Great price, Looks great and quality as expected.
reviews.comment:
Fans look great and comes with both long and short screws for installation, please avoid using the silicon tips as a screw replacement as the fans do not have the notches for the tips to be secured properly. Great looking fans nonetheless despite the price, you can daisy chain the fans as well using both the RGB connectors and the pwm power connectors..
Avoid attaching over 5 fans per RGB header just in case it causes instability in the motherboard.
reviews.author: Adrian Lewis

reviews.title: Its great, for the money you pay
reviews.comment: its great, it works very good quality. the value for money of 7 fans for 30$ in INSANE!!! Even at max rpm i find it very quiet. The looks are nice, tho i wish they made it look like the ‘others’ Brightness is good, apart from the infinity part at the edges where you can see the rgb begin to “fade”. If they could make the rgb a bit brighter, and add a little more to cover up the area its good. 4.7/5

reviews.title: Great fans for the price
reviews.comment: At first view these fans looked pretty thick and I wasn’t sure they’d fit, but I managed to get them into my small case just fine. Installation was a breeze. They work great for the price, and look pretty dang sweet to top it off. Recommend if you want all your fans for a bargain.
